values.guidance: Note outreach method and date; manage GDPR basis carefully

values.guidance: Highest value relationship; involve in key account planning; recognise and reward loyalty

values.guidance: Maintain cadence; invite to premium events; consider thought leadership collaboration

values.guidance: Nurture with relevant content; invite to appropriate events

values.label: Passive

values.guidance: Review contact preferences; consider targeted outreach

values.label: Disengaged
values.description: Not opening communications; no recent contact; at risk of lapsing.
values.guidance: Try alternative channel; consider removing from mailing lists if no response

values.label: Opted Out
values.description: Has requested to stop receiving marketing communications.
values.guidance: Comply immediately; remove from all marketing lists; retain in CRM for conflict purposes only

values.label: Identified
values.description: Added to the pipeline as a potential target; no contact made.
values.guidance: Assign to BD owner; set initial outreach date

values.guidance: Log touchpoint; send follow-up within 48 hours

values.guidance: Assign relationship partner; add to sector BD plan

values.guidance: Review client tier; consider key account status if volume warrants
